name: Clonitazene
summary: An opioid that is roughly three times as potent as Morphine. Is related to Etonitazene, which is about 1000-1500x the potency of Morphine.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: Like other nitazenes, it activates the mu opioid receptor, the main target of morphine.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他硝基咪唑類一樣，它會活化嗎啡的主要作用目標 μ 鴉片類受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他硝基咪唑类一样，它会活化吗啡的主要作用目标 μ 鸦片类受体。

sideEffects.en: It causes typical opioid effects such as drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence. As with other nitazenes, overdose can slow or stop breathing, and drugs of this family have caused many overdose deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、噁心、便秘與依賴等典型鴉片類作用。和其他硝基咪唑類一樣，過量可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止，這個家族的藥物已造成許多過量死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与依赖等典型鸦片类作用。和其他硝基咪唑类一样，过量可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止，这个家族的药物已造成许多过量死亡。

fact.en: It belongs to the benzimidazole opioids, or nitazenes, discovered by chemists at the Swiss company Ciba in the late 1950s. None was ever approved as a medicine, but some have recently appeared in the street drug supply.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯并咪唑類鴉片，也就是硝基咪唑類（nitazenes），由瑞士汽巴公司的化學家在 1950 年代後期發現。這類藥物從未獲准作為藥物使用，但近年部分已出現在街頭毒品市場中。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯并咪唑类鸦片，也就是硝基咪唑类（nitazenes），由瑞士汽巴公司的化学家在 1950 年代后期发现。这类药物从未获准作为药物使用，但近年部分已出现在街头毒品市场中。
